where: The Drownlight, floor 1 — the Oil Stores (the north coast's shuttered lighthouse, climbed in the dark)
mood: The Keeper's Hymn — a slow, tended sea-hymn in a cold stone tower: flute over harp, a clockwork ticking somewhere in the walls.
_note: Lane N2. The Drownlight family ANCHOR (music-cue-family skill): matches the classic drownlight-f1 (76 BPM, 3/4, D minor). The motif is a lamp's beam swinging out and back: up a fourth, lift to the third, fall home. Opening shape: a lone flute breathing the first phrase over a held harp chord (a cave-like 'lone instrument breathing in', never a stall). Never name the tune in a brief.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
airy sampled flute carrying a slow sea-hymn melody
harp arpeggios rising and falling like a turning lens
a soft clockwork tick on every beat from a small woodblock
melancholy, tended, patient, cold stone and lamp-oil
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a lone flute breathes the hymn's first rising phrase over one held harp chord, the clockwork tick starting under it}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the keeper's hymn on flute: up a fourth, a lift to the minor third, then a slow fall home, over rolling harp arpeggios and a string pad}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hymn again, a glass bell doubling the flute an octave up, a low cello line answering each phrase}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast in F major: the harp alone with the strings, warmer, like lamplight remembered, the clockwork ticking on}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the hymn returns on flute in D minor, the last bar lifting straight back into the top of the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
